conflicts.description: Preparation disperses 100 mg carbonized powder in 100 mL water before separation; catalytic solution is 24 mg/mL without reported concentration/isolation step.
conflicts.handling: Store precursor loading and catalytic concentration separately. Isolated CQD mass/yield and concentration method remain unknown.

conflicts.description: Preparation prose 0.22 µm membrane; Figure S1 drawing 0.2 µm.
conflicts.handling: Prose procedure 0.22 µm with conflicting diagram value attached.

conflicts.description: SI prints (0.2×0.5)/10=0.008 N; arithmetic gives 0.01 N. Conductometry uses 12 mL and reports 0.00833 N separately.
conflicts.handling: Do not replace the reported value; retain displayed calculation and distinguish assays.

conflicts.description: Main assigns low binding-energy O1s ~531.2 eV to C=O and high ~532.4 to C-OH; Table S2 reverses these group assignments.
conflicts.handling: Keep each interpretation with its source locator.

conflicts.description: SI prose carbonyl 162.35 ppm is absent from Figure S6 labelled peaks 161.298/159.630/...; main text uses isotope 19C while figure caption uses 13C; native/tagged CQD identity also ambiguous.
conflicts.handling: 13C technique from caption, source typo retained. Do not assert unique molecular structure or native/tagged aliquot match.

conflicts.description: Main prose says DCM failed; Figure 5c shows a high DCM yield spoke.
conflicts.handling: No numerical DCM yield extracted; retain graphical/prose discrepancy.

conflicts.description: Scheme 2 lists 11a: 60%*/78%# and 11b: 71%*/85%#, with text methods A/B; no A/B definitions or asterisk legend found in supplied main/SI.
conflicts.handling: Retain paired yield variants with unresolved method association. Do not infer microwave conditions from instrument listing.

conflicts.description: Coumachlor SI procedure names benzylideneacetone, while Scheme 2 R=Cl and product drawing require chlorinated aryl context.
conflicts.handling: Literal precursor and chlorinated product both retained; no silent reagent substitution.

conflicts.description: Main general claim of simple filtration/no chromatography conflicts with SI drug procedures using silica chromatography.
conflicts.handling: Filtration-only statement applies to scaffold-family procedures; drug workups are separate.

conflicts.description: Scheme S2 six-series branch labels NaN3 10 mmol, 0.46 g; four-series branch labels 10 mmol, 0.64 g.
conflicts.handling: Retain both printed amounts; do not use 0.46 g as a validated 10 mmol conversion.

conflicts.description: Scheme S2 reports 9a atom economy 86.93%; detailed SI 33 calculation reports 95.53%.
conflicts.handling: Separate reported metric contexts.

conflicts.description: 4e/6e/8e/9e titles say 4-hydroxyphenyl; drawings show 3-bromophenyl and listed masses belong to brominated series.
conflicts.handling: Retain literal names, source-labelled product IDs and drawn interpretation; molecular identity unresolved.

conflicts.description: 4g/6g/8g/9g titles say 4-fluorophenyl; drawings show 2-bromophenyl and listed masses are brominated.
conflicts.handling: No resolved molecular model or automatic formula normalization.

conflicts.description: SI 51 labels a trimethoxy structure/data 9f, duplicating 9i, whereas Figure S8 depicts 9f as dichloro.
conflicts.handling: Keep 9f scope yield separate; characterization identity unresolved.

conflicts.description: SI 52 indanedione phenoxy entry is printed 8h; spectrum captions 94–95 label 9h.
conflicts.handling: Contextual inventory ID 9h is an explicitly marked inference; raw printed 8h retained.

conflicts.description: 8j title SI 48 says hydroxynaphthalenone but drawing is coumarin; 4d spectrum captions 65–68 similarly say hydroxynaphthalenone while SI 35/main Figure 6 show coumarin.
conflicts.handling: Retain source-labelled identities; do not merge scaffold names silently.

conflicts.description: Scope drawings can place phenoxy at a different ring position from the 3-phenoxy names/drawings in characterization (especially 8h Figure S8).
conflicts.handling: Do not infer exact regioisomer from family letter alone; retain source-specific drawing pointers.

conflicts.description: Main 6a CH doublets 6.47–6.48/6.49–6.50 ppm conflict with SI 39 ranges 8.48–8.45/7.60–7.57 ppm; 4a main 6.16 vs SI 34 typed 6.14 while spectrum 55 labels 6.160.
conflicts.handling: NMR interpretation remains author attribution, not resolved tautomer proof.

conflicts.description: SI 87 caption says 13C NMR of 9a, but visible 0–13 ppm trace, peak labels and integration resemble/reproduce the proton trace SI 86.
conflicts.handling: Flag image as technique/caption inconsistent; do not use as valid 13C measurement. Typed 13C list SI 49 remains separately reported.

conflicts.description: 4b full proton spectrum SI 59 labels 9.935/6.141 ppm; extended SI 60 labels 9.999/6.205 ppm.
conflicts.handling: Do not treat the extended display as a verified crop of the same acquisition.

conflicts.description: Typed compound entries call MS EI, but supplied mass plots 58/68/77 display TOF MS ES+.
conflicts.handling: Keep reported method per evidence item; no exact-mass validation claim.

conflicts.description: Malformed literal tokens include 6h: 71.93.65, 8j: 139.87.1, 9c: 111,8; several distinct-product arrays duplicate. 9a 13C paragraph 75 MHz differs general 100 MHz.
conflicts.handling: Retain raw characterization strings; no automatic decimal repair or spectral fitting.
